test_title: PYST 67: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The price of fuel decreases by 35%, 55% and 35% in three successive months, but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let original price = 100

After 35% decrease ⇒ 100 × 0.65 = 65

After 55% decrease ⇒ 65 × 0.45 = 29.25

After 35% decrease ⇒ 29.25 × 0.65 = 19.0125

After 65% increase ⇒ 19.0125 × 1.65 = 31.37

Net change = 31.37 − 100 = −68.63%

**∴ Answer = 68.63% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −35%, −55%, −35%, +65%

**Formula used:**

Net factor = (1 − 0.35)(1 − 0.55)(1 − 0.35)(1 + 0.65)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net factor = 0.65 × 0.45 × 0.65 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.3137

⇒ Final price = 0.3137 × original

⇒ % change = (0.3137 − 1) × 100

⇒ = −0.6863 × 100 = −68.63%

**∴ The correct answer is 68.63% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Change

Multiply all change factors

Decrease/Increase

Decrease ⇒ (1 − x), Increase ⇒ (1 + x)

Net Effect

Compare final with original

Key Insight

Never add percentages directly
